functions.name: ReturnUntouchedSceneColorForPostProcessing
functions.docs: Returns the input scene color as a 2D texture output. This WILL perform a GPU copy if the override output is active or the input scene color was a 2D texture array slice.

functions.name: AddPostProcessMaterialPass
functions.signature: AddPostProcessMaterialPass(Target, Graph Builder, View, Inputs, Material Interface)
functions.docs:
Array of input textures bound to the material. The first element represents the output from
the previous post process and is required. All other inputs are optional.
